examples.label: Blog post card with a cover image
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-image" site="Global" src="/images/card-1.jpg" alt="A designer sketching a page layout on paper" loading="lazy" class="h-48 w-full object-cover" />
<.component component_name="chelekom-h5" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold">Designing pages your editors will actually use <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-2 text-zinc-600">Six rules we follow when turning a design file into blocks a non-technical editor can rearrange without breaking the page.

<.component component_name="chelekom-figure" site="Global" class="mx-auto max-w-2xl">
